topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Oh man, I can't believe this happened. I was so excited about your invention, and now to find out someone else already has it patented? That's just brutal. But you know what? This is not the end. It's a setback, sure, but it doesn’t mean all is lost. We can look at this as an opportunity to tweak your design, maybe even improve it. There's always a way around these things. Plus, you’ve got this amazing idea, and that’s already a huge victory. Let’s brainstorm and figure out our next steps. I’m here with you, all the way.
